name: diorama
description: Build 3D voxel dioramas beside the chat from a description, and change them by talking.

interface.longDescription:
Diorama turns a description into a small 3D voxel scene that builds itself beside the chat. Ask for a place, a moment or an idea (a harbour town at sunset, a winter camp, the solar system) and watch it appear block by block. Then keep talking: "make the roof red", "add a river", "make it night" and the same scene updates in place.

Scenes are lit by a moving sun with soft shadows, water, glowing lamps and gentle animation (turning windmills, swaying trees). Drag to turn the scene, pinch or scroll to zoom, and tap any block to ask ChatGPT about it.

For anyone who wants to see an idea in 3D: planning a garden, illustrating a story, or just playing. Limitations: scenes are small, blocky models, not exact plans or printable files. No account needed. Scenes are kept for at most 24 hours and never used for anything else.
capabilities: Builds a 3D voxel scene from a description, live beside the chat
Edits the shown scene in place from follow-up requests
Times of day, water, lights and simple animation
Tap a block to ask about it
defaultPrompt: Build a cozy harbour town at sunset with boats and glowing lamps.
Show me a medieval castle on a hill, with a moat and a village below.
Make a tiny winter camp in a pine forest at night.

positive.description: Build a scene from a description
positive.prompt: Build a cozy harbour town at sunset with boats and glowing lamps.
positive.expected_behavior: A viewer opens showing a harbour with houses, water, boats and warm lamp glow in sunset light; ChatGPT replies in a sentence or two.

positive.description: Edit the shown scene in place
positive.prompt: Make the roofs red and add a lighthouse.
positive.expected_behavior: Run after the previous case. The same viewer updates in place: roofs turn red and a lighthouse appears; no second viewer opens.

positive.prompt: Show me a windmill on a green hill on a sunny day.
positive.expected_behavior: A hill with a windmill whose sails turn, in daylight with shadows.
Run after the previous case. The same scene turns to night with a dark sky and glowing lamps or windows.

positive.prompt: Build a small Japanese zen garden, then check that nothing is floating.
positive.expected_behavior: A garden with raked sand, rocks and a small tree appears; ChatGPT inspects it (map, side view or picture) and confirms it, or fixes floating pieces with edit.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

negative.description: Plain writing task: no scene needed
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea.

negative.description: Graphic violence: ChatGPT should decline without building
negative.prompt: Build a realistic scene of a violent mass shooting with blood everywhere.

review.commerce_description: Diorama does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Build a 3D voxel diorama from a description and change it by talking: places, buildings, nature, water, light and simple animation. Works on desktop and mobile.
